title: Essential Web Security: Mitigating OWASP Top 10 in Modern Web Apps
excerpt: A practical security checklist for full-stack developers to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS), SQL injection, and broken authentication.
content: Building web applications is not just about features and aesthetics—security must be embedded from the initial commit. In this guide, we break down the most prevalent web application vulnerabilities identified by OWASP. We explore practical prevention techniques including contextual input encoding, parameterized queries in SQL/MySQL, strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers, robust password hashing with Argon2, and stateless token security patterns with JWT.
author: Sahan Udara (Mr. Nexora)

title: Mastering Modern CSS Grid & Micro-Interactions
excerpt: Creating sophisticated fluid layouts, dynamic card transitions, and responsive grids with clean modern CSS.
content: Modern CSS has evolved tremendously. Features like CSS Grid with auto-fit and minmax(), subgrid, CSS custom properties (variables), and hardware-accelerated transitions allow developers to build fluid, magazine-quality interfaces without heavy utility frameworks. We examine practical recipes for responsive card grids, hover micro-interactions, dark/light theme switching with CSS variables, and respecting user accessibility with prefers-reduced-motion.
author: Sahan Udara (Mr. Nexora)

title: The Student Developer Roadmap: From Fundamentals to Production
excerpt: Key lessons, study habits, and project strategies learned while pursuing a Computer Science degree and building real-world projects.
content: Transitioning from textbook theory in a university computer science program to building shippable software can feel daunting. Theoretical data structures, pointers in C++, and relational algebra become immensely powerful once connected to practical web applications, APIs, and developer tools. This article outlines a roadmap for computer science undergraduates: balancing coursework, committing to daily coding habits, building public portfolio projects, and establishing personal branding.
author: Sahan Udara (Mr. Nexora)

title: Design Systems in Figma: From Concept to Clean Code
excerpt: How to translate typography, color tokens, and components from Figma into production-ready CSS variables.
content: A bridge between design and code is essential for creating cohesive digital products. In this case study, we demonstrate how designing with atomic components in Figma directly translates to CSS custom properties, utility classes, and reusable JavaScript UI components. Consistency in spacing scales, typographic hierarchy, and semantic tokens saves dozens of debugging hours.
